title: JMAP shows nothing of what was stored while [jmap] was off
description: Found in step 7 (mimid-1vul.7, docs/design/agent-frontends.md §3 step 7). With [jmap] enabled = false no JmapExt is registered on the Store, so records saved in that run carry no ext["jmap"]. When JMAP is turned on again, AgentChat::over seeds only records that have ext["jmap"] (step 4's load rule, kept in step 6: 'no ext["jmap"] means no object'), so the rooms, people and messages of the JMAP-off run are invisible to JMAP clients for good; later changes to an unseen room are projected without its Chat. The same will hold for an IRC-only run (step 8). Choices: (a) at load, render a record without ext["jmap"] as a fresh JMAP object (step 6 rejected this because a Chat's members and other JMAP-only properties cannot be rendered exactly; a fresh object would get them as a first sync would), (b) keep JMAP's projection registered even with JMAP off (cost: a MemoryBackend nobody reads), (c) accept and document (done in mimid-agent's # Limitations). Nothing runs in production. Question for Mark: which?
